Chosen.note: The player the Exorcist chooses, not last night's pick.
Chosen.ambiguous: The wiki doesn't say whether the Exorcist may choose themself.

setupPrep.none: its tokens are only used after the first night or when something happens

reminderMovement.why: Placed on a new choice each night.

reminderPlaceholders.note: Marks the chosen player, who can't be chosen again the next night.

full.text: The Exorcist chooses a player (different to last night): move *CHOSEN* to them. Put the Exorcist to sleep. If they chose the Demon: wake the Demon, show the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* & Exorcist tokens and point to the Exorcist. The Demon does not act tonight.
full.reason: Says the Chosen token moves each night and what it stops.
